scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,blue "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @logue/web && npm run build -w @logue/extension && cd server && go build ./...
scripts.test: npm run test -w @logue/web && npm run test -w @logue/extension && cd server && go test ./...
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @logue/web && npm run typecheck -w @logue/extension
